title: Roland Mayfield, the Black Prince of East Liberty
summary: Roland Mayfield was a nightclub owner who taught her to drive and always rescued her when she was stranded on the road.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Yes. Roland Mayfield later on - there were 3 important people in my life, including the pianist that I spoke about -
Jack Howard. There was Roland Mayfield, when I was stranded at the age of 12 - I'd go out by myself a lot and he'd get in his car and pick me up and bring me home.
Roland Mayfield was a very important man.

He was what you call a sportsman; he had a nightclub and he became very wealthy among the people there in East Liberty and he was called the Black Prince of East Liberty. I met him when I was 12 years old. He taught me to drive a car. In fact there was about 6 young girls where we went to school. They could all drive but they had to ask me if they could drive the car. He played a very important part in my career.

He would always pick me up or give me anything that I needed. I would never write home and ask anybody for anything when I was out on the road. He would ask, "How's the kid?... She don't look and sound too good." He'd jump in his car, I don't care what was happening, even at work in his place of business, and pick me up and bring me home.
